items.name: Delhi Monsoon Open 2018
items.information: Online Registration ends on 14th July and On the spot registration is available on 22 July from 8:00 to 9:00. Visit [registration and payments tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DelhiMonsoonOpen2018#6392-registration-and-payments) for details. The main event for the competition is 2x2. 2x2 Winner will be declared the winner of Delhi Monsoon Open 2018.

venue.name: Angkringan Rute 57
venue.details: the venue in the main building of Angkringan Rute 57

items.information: Madiun Happy Cubing 2018 merupakan lomba rubik official ke 4 yang diadakan Madiun Cuber Community. Setiap peserta akan mendapatkan sertifikat, stiker, makan siang dan minum. Biaya pendaftaran adalah Rp 50.000 untuk early bird dan Rp 60.000 untuk on the spot. ________ Madiun Happy Cubing 2018 is the 4th official Rubik's competition held by Madiun Cuber Community. Every competitors will get certificate, sticker, lunch, and drink. The registration fee is Rp 50.000 for early bird and Rp 60.000 for on the spot payment.

items.name: Southern Azerbaijan Decathlon 2018
items.information: Cənub Dekatlon Yarışına xoş gəlmisiniz! Yarış iştirakçıların on kateqoriya üzrə xallar qazanacağı struktura əsaslanır. Yarış boyu ən çox xal toplamış yarışmaçı Cənub Dekatlon Çempionu olacaq. Xatırladaq ki, bu yarış adi DKA / WCA yarışı kimi olacaq. Dekatlon yarışı qeyri-rəsmidir. ________ Ödəniş: 50 AZN. Azərbaycan vətəndaşları üçün pulsuz. _________
